title: Fight Cloud Emoji (🫯): Codepoint, Meaning & the Century-Old Cartoon Cue
meta_description: The fight cloud emoji 🫯 (U+1FAEF): its Unicode 17.0 codepoint, how to type it, and why a scuffle has been drawn as a dust cloud for about a hundred years.
hero_tagline: The brawl cloud 🫯 with its codepoint, its input routes, the emotion shelf Unicode files it on, and the comic-strip convention it encodes. Tap the cloud to copy it, and the effect glyphs below are what people reached for before it.
intro: 🫯 FIGHT CLOUD (U+1FAEF) was added in Unicode 17.0 and reached most phones with iOS 26.4 in March 2026. It is filed under **emotion**, not under people or objects, because it depicts no one: the cloud is the convention comics use to hide a scuffle while telling you a scuffle is happening. Jennifer Daniel, who wrote the character's Unicode proposal, described it in April 2026 as a visual verb for when things get messy. This page covers the glyph, how to type it, and the effect symbols it belongs with.
